rules.name: shared-is-a-leaf
rules.reason: src/shared holds pure types and utilities used by every layer; it imports nothing else.

rules.name: analyzer-stays-node
rules.reason: The analyzer runs in the CLI, the MCP server and workers: no extension, webview or MCP code.

rules.name: mcp-standalone
rules.reason: The MCP server is a standalone Node stdio process: it reuses the analyzer, never the extension.

rules.name: cli-standalone
rules.reason: The CLI ships without VS Code.

rules.name: extension-no-webview-code
rules.reason: The extension host talks to the webview through messages typed in src/shared and runs the CLI as a separate process; it never bundles their code. It reuses MCP tool code for its language model tools.

rules.name: webview-is-browser-code
rules.reason: The webview is a browser bundle; it talks to the extension through messages typed in src/shared/types.ts.

rules.name: webview-no-analyzer-runtime
rules.reason: Type-only imports from the analyzer are erased at build time; anything else would pull Node code into the browser bundle.

rules.name: product-never-imports-tooling
rules.reason: Tests and scripts are not shipped; product code that imports them breaks the package.
